# 1Prompts

> A marketplace for premium, professionally crafted AI prompts for ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, and other AI tools.

1Prompts lets people browse and buy ready-to-use prompts by category, tool, and use case, and lets creators submit their own prompts for sale.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured prompts and an overview of the marketplace.
- [Browse](/browse): Search and filter all published prompts by category, price, and rating.
- [Categories](/categories): Prompt categories by AI tool and use case.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans and pricing for buyers.
- [API](/api): REST API documentation for accessing prompts.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on prompt engineering and AI workflows.
- [Submit a prompt](/submit-prompt): How creators can submit prompts for review.
- [About](/about): What 1Prompts is and who builds it.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the team.
- [Security](/security): Security practices for the platform.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How personal data is collected and used.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Refund Policy](/refunds): Refund eligibility and process for digital purchases.
